items.title: Memory Stocks Rally as Goldman Says the Worst May Be Over: SK Hynix Climbs 5%, SanDisk Advances 3%, Micron Gains 2%
items.summary: Goldman Sachs just flipped constructive on memory chips, sending SK Hynix, Micron, and SanDisk higher even as the broader market stumbles, but a major NAND supplier's warning about prices complicates the story.

items.title: Memory Is the New ‘King’ of Chips, Taking Over 50% of Semiconductor Revenue, Susquehanna Says
items.summary: Memory chips now account for 50%-55% of semiconductor industry revenue, up from roughly 20%-30% historically, according to Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini. Hosseini said Wednesday that memory has become the industry’s new “king” as AI data centers demand more of it....

items.title: Tech Analyst Paul Meeks Has A Warning for Apple in the Face of Its Biggest Launch Ever
